operations.summary: List third-party DNS / SMS / ICP provider plugins with their installation contract results
operations.description: Platform administrators with plugin_installations.read (or platform.admin). A provider plugin appears once its installation is enabled here and the license service serves its declaration (plugin_provider/<plugin id>). usable is true only while it is active, its contract passed for the current version and it is enabled.

operations.summary: Run the installation contract, enable or disable a provider plugin
operations.description: Platform administrators with plugin_installations.manage (or platform.admin). contract runs the cdnca.provider/v1 contract cases against the plugin sandbox and records the report; enable requires a passed contract for the current version (409 plugin_provider_contract_not_passed otherwise, also refused by the database). A payment plugin (high_risk) is a high-risk permission: enable needs risk_acknowledged (422 plugin_provider_risk_not_acknowledged) and an MFA step-up proof issued for the installation tenant with audience/action plugin.provider.enable_payment (403 plugin_provider_step_up_required); the proof is bound to the plugin declaration when consumed. Audited as plugin.provider.contract / enable / disable (refusals included).

responses.description: The provider plugin after the action.

fields.name: high_risk
fields.description: The plugin provides payment; enabling it needs risk_acknowledged and an MFA step-up.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Tenant of the plugin installation; the step-up proof is issued for it.
